title: copit registry index
description: Generated index a registry publishes as copit-registry.json. See https://huynguyengl99.github.io/copit/registry/

version.description: Index format version. copit refuses versions it does not understand.

source.description: Where the registry says it lives, e.g. github:owner/repo. Informational only: copit fetches components from the source the user configured, at the ref they pinned.

ecosystem.description: Selects the package manager. Unknown values simply disable installing.

variants.description: Names a component may specialise on, e.g. target frameworks.

componentId.description: Lowercase id without '/', unique across the registry.

target.description: Directory this registry suggests for its components. Recorded into registries.<name>.target by `copit registry add`; must be relative and inside the project.

package_marker.description: File created in every directory copit creates, for languages that need one.

exclude.description: Generator-side default: glob patterns the registry never publishes. copit copies exactly what each component lists in `files`, so this is not applied at install time.

optional.description: Generator-side default for named optional groups. copit copies only what each component materialises into its own `optional` map.

optionalGroup.description: One named group, as a bare file list or as an object that also declares what those files need. `requires` and `dependencies` apply only when the group is selected with --with.

include.description: Files copied when the group is selected.

requires.description: Other components in this registry, resolved only when the group is selected.

dependencies.description: Packages needed only when the group is selected.

include.description: Files copied only when this variant is selected.

tier.description: Free-form label such as core or contrib. copit treats it as opaque.

path.description: Directory within the registry repository. Its basename becomes the installed directory name.

requires.description: Other components in this registry, resolved transitively. Must be acyclic.

only_variants.description: Variants this component requires; empty installs anywhere. Unlike `variants`, which only adds files, this refuses the install when none is selected. Every name must appear in the registry's `variants`.

files.description: Exactly what a normal install copies, excludes already applied.

optional.description: Named groups installed only when requested with --with.
